{{DISPLAYTITLE:En_GirlA}}
{{Actor|name=ovl_En_GirlA|ispage=true}}
'''ovl_En_GirlA''' is an [[actor]] that makes up the items sold in shops. This actor contains code for rendering the items within the shops, and contains the data related to item being sold. They are spawned by [[ovl_En_Ossan]] (Shopkeeper) actors.

==Shop Item Data Format==
* Debug Rom 0xDF3254
* NTSC 1.0 0xC022CC

=== Deku Nut example===
<tt>oooo ssss 8002ED80</tt><br>
<tt>pppp cccc dddd bbbb</tt><br>

<tt>iiiiiiii  80A3ABF8</tt><br>
<tt>80A3B714  80A3BB6C</tt><br>

'''o''' - [[Object| Object number]]. [[Rooms]] are expected to load the appropriate object files for the item model to load<br>
'''s''' - Get Item model index (also known as "shader" number in older docs)<br>
'''p''' - Actual Item Price. Changing this value will not change the displayed price.<br>
'''c''' - "Pieces" (for ammo and such)<br>
'''d''' - [[Text Id]] used for displaying the item description text.<br>
'''b''' - [[Text Id]] used for displaying the purchased item text.<br>
'''i''' - [[ovl_player_actor/Get_Items#Get_Item_Table|Get Item index]]

Object/Get Item model index pairs are documented on the [[ovl_player_actor/Get_Items|Get Items]] page. 

For instance, if you edit the heart entry:

 00B7 0008 00000000 000A0010 00AC0095
 0000 0048 80A3B204 80A3B8F0 80A3BB6C
to
 00BA 0010 00000000 000A0010 00AC0095
 0000 0048 80A3B204 80A3B8F0 80A3BB6C

...to display the light medallion, you'll need to replace the 00B7 object in the shop's map with the 00BA object, and change the model index from 0008 to 0010 to get it to load. It will still be a heart, though; only the graphic has changed.

You can use UoT, ZLE, or ZAP2 to do this, or if you're gifted you can do it manually with a hex editor.
